scientific.integrity: The proof is an all-parameter cyclic-run classification and composition count. A standalone exhaustive verifier reconstructs the complexes for \(3\le k\le14\) and is used only as a finite cross-check.
scientific.limitations: The theorem gives the exact face vector and Euler characteristic on \(n=k+6\), but does not prove shellability for \(k\ge4\). The wedge multiplicity is conditional on the published shellability conjecture.

title: Exact face vector on the \(n=k+6\) squared-cycle cut-complex diagonal
